description: Inspect one page of documents already available for an extraction task_id, including while processing. Each documents[].id is a document ID usable by fetch_document_result, fetch_json_results, or download_results; extraction_data contains that document's current data. Pass next_cursor as cursor with the same task_id to get the next page. next_cursor null ends this snapshot, not task processing; use wait_for_task_extraction to determine completion. To refresh later, omit cursor and deduplicate by document ID. This returns a page, not a complete export.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous page of this task. Omit or pass null to start a fresh snapshot; never construct a cursor.

limit.description: Maximum documents in this page: 1 to 100, default 25.

name: get_task_results
title: Get Task Results
